'''Ganga Town''' (Japanese: '''ダンダタウン''' ''Danda Town'') is the hometown of [[Gavin]]. It was mentioned in ''[[AG127|From Brags to Riches]]''. It is unknown where it is located.

==Trivia==
* The dub name of this location is similar to the Japanese name of [[Muscle Island]], "Ganga Island".
